How to verify: Confirm access, finished surfaces, environmental conditions, power, lighting, protection, and other-trade status.
Pass criteria: The work can proceed without predictable damage or blocked access.

How to verify: Transfer and verify the governing level, plumb, centerline, elevation, or wall reference at the work area.
Pass criteria: Every installed component traces to the same checked reference.

How to verify: Locate structure, services, membranes, hazards, and no-fastener zones using appropriate records and methods.
Pass criteria: Anchoring and cutting avoid unverified hidden conditions.

How to verify: Record variance, proposed correction, approval, affected parts, and updated documents before alteration.
Pass criteria: A field fix cannot silently change design, safety, function, or future service.

How to verify: Mark module widths, corners, doors, drawers, rods, shelves, outlets, access panels, and obstructions.
Pass criteria: All components fit and can operate in the actual room.

How to verify: Verify wall construction, cleats, vertical supports, feet, anchors, and hardware limits.
Pass criteria: Loads transfer through the intended supported path.

How to verify: Test reach, hanging lengths, aisle width, drawer projection, hamper removal, and door swing.
Pass criteria: The installed storage is usable, not merely dimensionally possible.
